g.text: NPU stage scaling during ordinary concurrent FFN calls
Host stages include BO I/O, submission, device execution and waits; they are not pure compute or DMA.
Layout times are summed per invocation before aggregation. Bars: sample p10–p90. Independent medians are not additive.
